treaty_name: Agreement between the People's Republic of China and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital (1994), as modified by the MLI
eif_quote: Art. 29: "This Agreement shall enter into force on the thirtieth day after the date on which diplomatic notes ... have been exchanged. This Agreement shall have effect: (a) in respect of taxes withheld at source, to income derived on or after 1 January of the calendar year next following that in which this Agreement enters into force;" (EIF date 1995-07-28 from STA list via map.json)
source_title: STA English text of the 1994 China-Luxembourg Agreement (Wayback copy of chinatax.gov.cn PDF); Chinese text also read

rates.quote: (a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
(b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that Contracting State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
(a) in the case of royalties referred to in sub-paragraph (a) of paragraph 3 of this Article, 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties; and

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Royalties: Art. 12(2)(b) - equipment royalties (Art. 12(3)(b)) capped at 10% of the adjusted amount = 60% of gross (effective 6%), not modelled as separate tier. Interest: Art. 11(3) exempts interest derived by the other State's Government (as defined, incl. central bank/state institutions), local authorities, or on debt-claims guaranteed, insured or indirectly financed by them. MLI Art. 8 365-day rule does NOT apply: Luxembourg reserved the entirety of Art. 8 (Art. 8(3)(a)), although China notified Art. 10(2)(a). MLI WHT effect from 2023-01-01 per map.json (LU MLI EIF 2019-08-01, CN 2022-09-01; SAT Announcement 2022 No.16).
unverified: MLI synthesised text not read; PPT quote is MLI Art. 7(1) wording
